Topic 1.6.2: Uses of heat in

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Uses of heat in. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify uses of heat energy in the environment
2. use heat energy responsibly to promote conservation and safety
3. appreciate conservation of heat energy in daily life. energy in the environment to conserve heat energy (when warming, ironing, cooking, drying) 118

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify uses of heat energy in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify uses of heat energy in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use heat energy responsibly to promote conservation and safety
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use heat energy responsibly to promote conservation and safety. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate conservation of heat energy in daily life. energy in the environment to conserve heat energy (when warming, ironing, cooking, drying) 118

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Uses of heat in.
2. Explain Uses of heat in to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should discuss uses of heat How is heat energy environment learner should be able to: energy (warming, cooking, used in daily life? a) identify uses of heat energy in the ironing, drying) environment
4. Show that you can: identify uses of heat energy in the environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Uses of heat in. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Uses of heat in important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
